basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Post Doctoral Fellowship Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Kharagpur has invited online applications for one Post Doctoral Fellowship - Research post in the temporary research project "Compute on Demand in 6G Network" (Project Code – R/CED), sponsored by Ericsson India Private Limited. The essential qualification is a PhD in CSE/ECE or related departments (in the area of Computer Systems and Networks). The upper age limit is 35 years, no application fee is shown, and the last date is 27 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Apply online for the assignment advertised under Advertisement No. IIT/SRIC/R/CED/2026/109 on or before 27 November 2026.

The application fee is shown as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST. The notice says the fee is to be deposited by RTGS/NEFT/NET Banking etc. into the account of State Bank of India (00202), account name IIT SRIC-OM Account, account number 39502115210, IFSC code SBIN0000202, SWIFT code SBININBB339.
The bank address printed is P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302.
Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints one vacancy for the single post and no category break-up. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: PhD in CSE/ECE or related departments (in the area of Computer Systems and Networks), Minimum 70% marks or 7.5 CGPA in Class 10, 12, UG and PG.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice prints the consolidated compensation per month as "upto 0 (depending on qualification and experience)". The tenure is printed as "100000 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier". The notice describes the assignment as temporary and the project as purely time bound.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to candidates being called for the interview and says that meeting the minimum qualifications and experience does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called. It prints no interview date, mode or marking scheme.

faq.question: Q1. How many Post Doctoral Fellowship - Research posts has IIT Kharagpur announced?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 post of Post Doctoral Fellowship - Research in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A PhD in CSE/ECE or related departments (in the area of Computer Systems and Networks), with minimum 70% marks or 7.5 CGPA in Class 10, 12, UG and PG.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules if any.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notice shows the application fee as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. The UTR No. or Transaction ID details must be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates who have not yet defended their PhD apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says candidates who have submitted their thesis but are waiting for the defense can also apply. Without the degree, they can be recruited as "Senior Research Engineer" with appropriate salary.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent post?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary assignment in a purely time bound research project. The tenure is printed as 100000 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Who funds the project?
faq.answer: The sponsoring agency is Ericsson India Private Limited. The project is "Compute on Demand in 6G Network", with Prof./Dr. Sandip Chakraborty as PI/Co-PI.
